fields.option_statement: Close the inner lane of Dock Road for 25 days to build a bike lane.
fields.mechanism: The road works office closes one lane in phases and keeps a lane open for traffic.
fields.authority_and_legal_basis: A closure under thirty days needs no ministerial order under the invented statutes of Fiktiva.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: The bike lane is open and counted on the public sheet after 25 days.

fields.risks_and_rights_impact: Traffic slows on two days. A lane stays open for emergency vehicles.
lawful_alternatives: Paint a shared lane without a closure.
assumptions: I assume the closure can be phased.

fields.option_statement: Pilot a second weekly pickup on Dock Road for six weeks.
fields.mechanism: The waste services office adds one extra round on market days and logs each round.
fields.authority_and_legal_basis: The invented rules of Fiktiva North let the waste services office add rounds within its yearly budget.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: The extra round is logged and the weekly count is posted on the public sheet.

fields.risks_and_rights_impact: Noise on market mornings rises slightly. No personal data is collected.
lawful_alternatives: Move the existing round to the early morning.
assumptions: I assume the closure can be phased.

fields.option_statement: Review the pilot with residents at the market hall.
fields.mechanism: The poster hosts one open session and posts the notes to the stage.
fields.authority_and_legal_basis: Hosting an open session in a public hall needs no permit under the invented statutes of Fiktiva.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: The notes and the attendance count are posted to the stage.

fields.risks_and_rights_impact: Attendance may be low. Notes name no individual.
lawful_alternatives: Collect written comments for two weeks.
assumptions: I assume the closure can be phased.
